clause: DESIGN R3.3 §2.4.1 L195 CR-10; §8.3 L655 and L659 widget and parameter rules; §10.1 L737
derivation: The composed neutral fixture satisfies CR-10: every UI entry and field binds each required recipe parameter exactly once with a type-compatible source (owner/target/source->element, value->string, key->string), the enum field has three distinct values, reference fields have targetTypes, the readonly field omits command and the immutable reference field (mutable op false) may omit command. Parity sync PS-35 (DESIGN §10.1 L737: PureResult success is exactly {status, payload, diagnostics}): the outcome is {status ok, payload, empty diagnostics} whose payload, the CompiledProfile (no wire shape), is unsealed as compiled-profile; the compiled identity, equal to the fixture identity, is sealed separately as expected.compiledIdentity (parity role compiled-identity). The identity values are unchanged.
